name: ai-dlc-lens
description: Claude Code only: a live view of an AI-DLC run. The workflow pane draws each feature root of a run (its top-level step) as its own flowchart of agents (persona, model, role, status), highest step first, every sub-step under its parent step, with hand-off and agent panels that show the records, tool calls, background tasks, tokens, context window and cost; a one-line card in the chat opens it and draws one chart per task. Settings in .ai-dlc/lens.json.
